verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that both the consumer app and the API deliver answers grounded in real-time web search with inline citations, and one hands-on user says it replaced Google for their needs. A hands-on report of links and references frequently mismatched to the text, plus a report that it cites SEO-spam listicles, weakens citation fidelity but does not contradict that the capability exists. Missing for 10: independent verification that citations reliably match the claims they support, and evidence on source-quality filtering.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: Get accurate, up-to-date answers grounded in real-time web search, with inline citations in a single call, and conversation context across turns.
